title: Tailorable conductivity of 3D PEDOT-based conductive nanostructures with pH-responsivity via a direct femtosecond laser writing technique
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6026-6031
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10027E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qingbin Zhou, Yucheng Long, Shichao Song, Zilan Deng, Xiangping Li, Yaoyu Cao
A two-step femtosecond laser direct writing technique enables pH-responsive 3D PEDOT-based nanostructures with feature size down to 250 nm and tunable conductivity (454–1041 S m−1), promising for adaptive nanoelectronics and biosensors.
